BALDURS_ENEMYS-DAME_AYLIN.title: Dame Aylin
BALDURS_ENEMYS-DAME_AYLIN.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 Artifacts. At the start of your turn, roll 1d4 and gain that much Block. If Isobel is present on the opposing side, she dies immediately.
BALDURS_ENEMYS-DAME_AYLIN.flavor: The moonlight shall shield you, until your final breath.
BALDURS_ENEMYS-BALDURANS_GIANTSLAYER.des: At the start of each combat, roll for Strength: normal fights 1d4; elite fights 1d8; boss fights roll 2d20 and gain (sum/3) Strength (rounded down), plus an extra 1d20 Strength if either die shows a 20 (a second 20 does not roll again).
BALDURS_ENEMYS-BALDURANS_GIANTSLAYER.fla: The blade remains; the dragonslayer is gone.
